metadata.title: Bayesian Diagnostic Insights: A Software Tool for Applying Bayes' Theorem in Medical Diagnostics
metadata.description: This software tool is a specialized program developed in Wolfram Language for the parametric estimation, visualization, and comparison of Bayesian diagnostic measures and their uncertainty. The program utilizes Bayes' theorem to compute the posterior probabilities for disease and absence of the disease, as well as the diagnostic threshold-derived positive and negative predictive values. It uses advanced uncertainty propagation methods to quantify their standard sampling, measurement, and combined uncertainty using normal, lognormal, and gamma distributions. The tool enhances the estimation process and facilitates the comparison of these Bayesian diagnostic measures, which are critical for medical practice. Furthermore, it provides a robust framework for analyzing uncertainty, thereby aiding in the understanding and applying of probabilistic methods in medical diagnostics.
metadata.notes: Bayesian Diagnostic Insights can be run on Wolfram Player® or Wolfram Mathematica®

metadata.title: 中医经济学(Traditional Chinese Medicine Economics)
metadata.description:
内容概要:

本书是中医经济学作为一门独立学科的奠基之作。承继前人开拓,本书完成了从“方法论类比”到“本体论革命”、从“政策应用”到“学科体系”、从“哲学思辨”到“科学实证”的三重跃迁,标志着经济学范式的一次深刻变革。

全书二十一章仿照中医“医道”精心构筑,形成“道—体—用—证—诊—治—境”的完整认知闭环:从哲学根基与人性论革命出发,经经济生命体论、气血经络五行等本体构造与运行机理,通过病理分析与诊断辨证,最终归于治疗方略与文明境界。

本书以“经济生命体论”颠覆西方经济学的机械本体论,将经济系统确认为具有自组织、自适应、自我调节能力的生命有机体;以“气血经络五行”重构要素、产业与区域理论,为经济学提供非还原论的整体分析范式。在治理层面,“四诊合参”“八纲辨证”“八法调控”“政策复方”等工具可直接转化为宏观经济决策的操作手册,实现从“逆周期调节”到“辨证管理”、从“挑选赛道”到“调理生态”的方法论跃迁。在危机应对上,“内外合邪”病因学与“扶正祛邪”原则,为防范化解系统性风险提供了超越单一归因的系统方案。本书最终指向中国自主经济学知识体系的构建,为全球治理贡献“阴阳平衡”的东方智慧,使经济学从“修理机器”的技术官僚之学,升华为“调理生命”的治理艺术。

metadata.title: Collaborative Tools and Communication Platforms for Remote Learning
metadata.description: The COVID-19 pandemic has dramatically transformed the educational landscape, rapidly accelerating the global shift toward remote learning and emphasizing the urgent need for robust and effective collaborative tools and communication platforms. As schools and universities adapted to the unprecedented circumstances of widespread lockdowns and physical distancing, these technologies became essential for maintaining instructional continuity and fostering student engagement in virtual environments. This review delves into the existing body of literature on the subject, critically analysing the effectiveness of various collaborative tools and communication platforms in supporting remote learning. It also explores the challenges that educators and institutions have faced in implementing these technologies, such as issues related to technical difficulties, equity, access, and the digital divide. Furthermore, the review outlines best practices for integrating these tools into educational frameworks, stressing the importance of adequate teacher training, inclusive access, and supportive learning environments to ensure the successful adoption and sustained use of these technologies. By offering a comprehensive understanding of these key areas, this study aims to provide valuable insights for educational institutions seeking to enhance their remote learning programmes and optimise student outcomes in a post-pandemic world.

metadata.title: PREDICTIVE MAINTENANCE OF PRODUCTION EQUIPMENT USING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE METHODS
metadata.description: The work provides a comprehensive analysis of modern approaches to predictive maintenance of production equipment using artificial intelligence methods. It examines the features of reactive, preventive, and predictive maintenance strategies, as well as the principles for building predictive maintenance systems. Modern machine learning methods are analyzed, including Random Forest, LSTM, GRU, Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, and autoencoders, highlighting their advantages, limitations, and suitability for tasks such as classifying equipment condition, predicting remaining equipment life, and detecting anomalies. The typical architecture of predictive maintenance systems has been summarized, and a comparative analysis of modern industrial predictive maintenance platforms has been carried out. Based on a review of the literature, an original qualitative comparison of machine learning methods and a generalized scheme of how predictive maintenance systems function have been developed. It was found that the effectiveness of such systems depends on a combination of quality data preparation, the choice of machine learning algorithms, and architectural decisions. The results obtained can be used as a methodological basis for designing intelligent predictive maintenance systems for production equipment in various industrial sectors.

metadata.title: CORRUPTION AS AN EXTRAORDINARY CRIME: EVALUATING THE RULE OF LAW, DEMOCRACY AND HUMAN RIGHTS
metadata.description: Corruption categorized as an extraordinary crime continues to show a significant upward trend in Indonesia. As a product of the 1998 reform movement, efforts to realize a clean government were institutionalized through Law Number 28 of 1999. However, empirical realities show a structural anomaly where democratic instruments are hijacked by old power structures acting as free riders to perpetuate authoritarian tendencies. This systemic failure degrades the rule of law and forces a critical re-examination of how political transitions accommodate oligarchic resilience. Consequently, this study addresses how corruption undergoes structural metamorphosis, how state capture interacts with democratic procedures, and to what extent it deprives citizens of constitutional protections. Research Method, using a combined legal research method (normative-empirical jurisprudence) with a qualitative-descriptive approach, this study dissects State Capture Corruption through Olle Törnquist’s "shadowy democracy" thesis and Nils Bubandt's oxymoronic democracy corruption framework. Research Outcome: The results confirm that local oligarchies distort political transitions through the capitalization of authority and Sophistic truth manipulation. This paradox turns democracy into an incubator for systemic corruption, where public funds are diverted, leaving the public as a collective victim. The novelty lies in integrating Samuel Huntington’s transition models to reveal a "transformation from above" using fresh data. Theoretically, it enriches progressive criminal jurisprudence, while practically providing strategic policy recommendations for anti corruption authorities to shield public budgets from oligarchic interventions.

metadata.title: Comparative profitability analysis of land uses between Eucalyptus woodlot and crop production: evidence from Dangila Woreda, Northwest Ethiopia
metadata.description: This study assessed the financial profitability of two land use systems (Eucalyptus versus crop production) in Dangila Woreda, where there is a significant shift toward Eucalyptus woodlots. The expansion of Eucalyptus on arable land competes with food crop production and threatens household food security in the study area. Previously, land use allocation was not based on systematic feasibility assessments. This study evaluated the profitability of the two land uses using financial indicators (NPV and BCR). A multi-stage sampling technique was used to select 316 respondents from four randomly selected kebeles. To evaluate financial profitability, both primary and secondary data were used, including focus group discussions, key informant interviews, and household surveys. The collected data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, t-tests, chi-square tests, trend analysis, and NPV and BCR analyses. The results showed that Eucalyptus woodlot plantations have increased in area over time. The profitability analysis indicated that the Eucalyptus investment generates a significantly higher NPV of 193,978.66 ETB/ha and a BCR of 4.69, whereas crop production yields an NPV of 162,699.13 ETB/ha and a BCR of 1.32. Across sensitivity analysis scenarios, Eucalyptus plantations consistently provide higher net returns and a more favorable return on investment. Despite its higher return, the Eucalyptus planting site must be identified and chosen in consultation with experts to minimize competition with food production.
